title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-09-21
summary: Weekly infra update focused on GPU fleet health, recent eu-west1 incident, region capacity planning for APAC ramp, and upcoming maintenance window.
body:
TL;DR:
- Added 32 T4-equivalent nodes (128 GPUs) to hosted pool in us-west1 to handle demo/daytime traffic; immediate uplift in throughput.
- eu-west1 incident on 2026-09-18 caused ~3h degradation for some Dedicated customers; autoscaler misconfig + faulty node image rollout identified as root cause.
- Planning reserved capacity purchase for EU and APAC: proposal to reserve 64 A100s (eu-west1) and 48 A100s (ap-northeast1) to hit latency SLOs for enterprise customers.
- Maintenance window scheduled 2026-09-28 02:00-06:00 UTC for node-image upgrade in us-east1 and us-west1 (rolling, no expected downtime).

Highlights and context:
- Ongoing APAC pilot (customer X) is ramping earlier than expected; current on-demand capacity in ap-northeast1 is close to 82% during peak hours. Need to secure reserved capacity or add burst nodes.
- Hosted API latency improved 5% p50 after new batching kernel landed on runtime. Observed small regressions in p99 for long-sequence (>4096) requests in eu-west1 clusters. Engineering tracking.

GPU fleet status:
- Total GPUs (all regions): 420
- Healthy GPU nodes: 412 (98%)
- Degraded nodes: 8 (rolling reboots/replaced)
- Average GPU utilization (week): 63%
- Peak utilization observed: 92% (ap-northeast1, 2026-09-19 03:00 UTC)
- Notes: Newly provisioned T4 nodes in us-west1 are running on image v2026-09-15; no regressions seen so far.

Regions & capacity planning:
- us-west1: Added capacity to support demo traffic; buffer now ~18% above baseline.
- us-east1: Stable; preparing node-image rollout during maintenance window.
- eu-west1: Impacted by incident; currently operating with reduced autoscaler headroom due to conservative rollback. Proposal: reserve 64 A100s (contract negotiation in progress) to reduce spillover to fallback models.
- ap-northeast1: Pilot customers driving peak; recommend procuring 48 reserved A100s or using dedicated burst pool if procurement cannot be fast-tracked.

Incidents and postmortem summary:
- 2026-09-18 eu-west1 capacity degradation (3 hours)
  - Symptom: elevated request queues and increased timeouts for some Dedicated customers between 09:12-12:18 UTC.
  - Root cause: faulty node image (v2026-09-17) triggered a subset of nodes to fail health checks combined with an autoscaler bug that prevented rapid replacement.
  - Mitigations applied: rolled back node image to v2026-09-14, temporarily increased min-replicas in autoscaler, manually reprovisioned 16 nodes.
  - Long-term fixes: autoscaler patch merged (PR-812), add pre-rollout canary check for node-image health, update runbook to force scale-to-zero guardrails.

Metrics snapshot (week):
- avg-hosted-requests-per-minute: 14,200
- avg-embeddings-requests-per-minute: 4,300
- average-p50-latency-text-generation: 85ms
- average-p99-latency-text-generation: 720ms
- gpu-hours-used: 13,560
- cost-per-gpu-hour (avg): $2.10

Risks / blockers:
- Contract lead times for A100 reservations in APAC are uncertain (vendor quoting 6-8 weeks). If procurement delay happens, we will see degraded quality for APAC enterprise workloads.
- Autoscaler edge-case for simultaneous node-image rollouts still has a small failure window; engineering is adding conservative locks in control plane.

Action items (owners):
action_items: Evan Kim: finalize eu reserved capacity term sheet by 2026-09-24 (INFRA-3421)
Jordan Lee: schedule and run pre-rollout canary for node-image upgrades (due 2026-09-25)
Priya Narayanan: coordinate APAC capacity procurement and present options to finance by 2026-09-27
SRE: enable temporary increased min-replicas during next 2 rollouts (runbook update PR)
decisions: Approve provisional reservation: 64 A100s in eu-west1 and 48 A100s in ap-northeast1 pending finance sign-off
Postpone non-critical kernel experiments in eu-west1 until autoscaler patch is fully validated
next_steps: Run full capacity simulation for APAC traffic profile by 2026-09-24
Merge autoscaler fix to prod and monitor for 48h (owner: Jordan Lee)
Finalize maintenance runbook and notify CS + Dedicated customers 48h before 2026-09-28 maintenance window
